feature: Ask runs on the best model this Mac can hold
summary: Ask now runs on qwen3.6:27b, a model that can see, picked by scoring ten local models on the eval. It doubles the held-out score of the old model (35.9 against 18.2) and looks at its own drawings, so a second looking model is no longer needed.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default, nothing chosen in Settings > Ask (Automatic). Ollama 0.40.7 with qwen3.6:27b pulled (18 GB). Bake-off on an M4 Max with 64 GB.

try.do: Open Settings > Ask and check that the Model row reads Automatic (qwen3.6:27b).
Open the settings screenshot, press Ask, type "annotate the ux with measurements around the major ui elements" and press Return.
On a blank canvas, press Ask and type "draw a picture of a dog."
Ask for something the built-in set has no drawing of ("draw a heron standing in reeds") and watch Ask look at its own drawing before it hands back.
Ask for a video edit on the sample recording: "cut this clip where the copying starts and put a dissolve across it".

evaluate: Does Ask feel quick enough? It answers the simple requests in about 4 seconds, but the median on the harder held-out requests is 26 to 31 seconds.
Are drawings Ask makes itself (not from the built-in set) clearly better than before?
Is three fifths of the Mac's memory the right limit, so a 36 GB Mac gets qwen3:30b and a 32 GB Mac gets gemma4:e4b?
Is qwen3.6:27b worth being slower than qwen3.6:35b? 35b scored 31.5 on the held-out set at 7.9 seconds, against 35.9 at 26 to 31 seconds for 27b.
rough: The table, per model (climb / held-out total, held-out groups drawing, layout, redline, video, seconds a request median climb / held-out, GB held, broken tool calls climb / held-out): qwen3.6:27b 74.1 / 35.9 (35.1, 23.9, 33.9, 60), 3.6 / 26.1 s, 29.9 GB, 1 of 64 / 18 of 128. qwen3.6:35b 72.4 / 31.5 (32.7, 10.8, 11.2, 58.2), 1.3 / 7.9 s, 32.7 GB, 0 of 64 / 27 of 156. gemma4:26b 71.6 / 26.4 (24.9, 19.3, 34.4, 43), 7.9 / 9.6 s, 25.7 GB, 0 of 66 / 19 of 129. qwen3:30b, the model before, 71.4 / 18.2 (20.1, 4.2, 15.9, 12.5; held-out run on Ollama 0.20.2), 10.8 s, 21.9 GB, 3 of 74. gemma4:e4b 74.3 / 13.5 (15.9, 5.1, 0, 7.4), 4.2 / 4.6 s, 18.6 GB, 0 of 42 / 14 of 57.

Climb only, too slow or not working: qwen3-vl:30b 74.7 at 28 s, its held-out run stopped after 6 of 45 cases at about 5 minutes a case. gemma4:31b 75.3 at 56.5 s. gemma4:12b 71.7 at 20.4 s, 17.3 GB. mistral-small3.2:24b never called a tool ("I can't draw a picture"), scored 0 on all of its first 13 cases at 47 s a turn, stopped there. qwen3-vl:8b took 42 to 300 s a request, stopped after 7 cases.

The -mlx tags scored the same as the plain ones (qwen3.6:27b-mlx 75.5, qwen3.6:35b-mlx 74.6, gemma4:26b-mlx 73.7; gemma4:31b-mlx took 53 to 79 s, stopped after 6 cases). On Apple Silicon, Ollama 0.40.7 already runs the plain qwen3.6 and gemma4 tags on its MLX engine, so the plain tag is the default.

Blind naming is not its own column. It is part of each drawing case's score, and the held-out set is read as totals only. On the climb set every model named 3 of 3 on nearly every drawing, because the climb drawings come from the built-in set whatever the model.

One model against two: qwen3.6:27b looking with itself scored the same 35.9 as with llama3.2-vision looking, held 11 GB less and needs no second download, but its held-out median went from 26.1 s to 31.1 s, 1.1 s over the 30 second bar. The climb median is 3.6 s. Chose one model as the task asks, and counted 27b as under the bar on its two held-out runs (26.1 and 31.1) and its climb run.

The memory rule (three fifths of the Mac's memory): 48 GB or more gets qwen3.6:27b, 36 GB gets qwen3:30b (cannot see), 32 GB gets gemma4:e4b, 24 GB or less gets nothing and Settings says Ask needs more memory than this Mac has. Only 64 GB was measured. A 48 GB Mac with a slower chip would run the dense 27b about twice as slowly.

Ollama was updated from 0.20.2 to 0.40.7 first. The models that lost were removed again, so the disk is as it was plus qwen3.6:27b (18 GB). qwen3:30b and llama3.2-vision are still on the Mac, as they were before.

The held-out pictures for the final run are in .ask-eval/held-out-runs/20261021-234253-ask-held-out/ (Scripts/ask-eval.sh sheet 20261021-234253-ask-held-out). They are not copied here because runners must not see them.
